defects.title: Reports page crashed (blank page, TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading report)') when a report was clicked in the list while none was selected
defects.root_cause: useApi keeps the previous state until its effect runs; with the new ?id the first render had data=null and loading=false, and the page dereferenced data.report
defects.fix: render the loading state whenever data is not yet available
defects.evidence: UI-E-010b (browser regression test); first crawl logged the pageerror

defects.title: 'Evaluate' started unlimited concurrent GPU evaluations; four clicks produced four failed jobs (CUDA out of memory, 'paging file is too small', array allocation failure) and the UI gave no feedback
defects.root_cause: POST /api/models/{id}/evaluate spawned a subprocess per call with no check for running jobs on a 4 GB GPU; the Models page showed nothing on success
defects.fix: 409 job_already_running while any job is running/queued (ConflictError); UI shows 'Evaluation started ... one job runs at a time'
defects.evidence: jobs job-89b879436e, job-82c79d0718, job-74efa27ace, job-f27703cc07 (failed); unit test

defects.title: Models page 'Use' for the numbering checkpoint returned HTTP 422
defects.root_cause: ModelSelectRequest.task Literal lacked 'numbering' although the registry supports it
defects.fix: added 'numbering'

defects.title: GET /api/analyses/{id}/overlay returned 404 'no detections' for every full-pipeline analysis
defects.root_cause: overlay_png only understood the older 'detections' payload, full analyses store 'regions'
defects.fix: draw regions with FDI number, candidate class and a review marker; no class drawn for abstained regions

defects.title: Report validator accepted impossible evidence (probability 1.7, label 'Healthy') and flagged Deep-Caries-only reports for mentioning 'caries'
defects.root_cause: validate_report compared report to evidence but never validated the evidence; the vocabulary scan matched 'caries' inside 'Deep Caries'
defects.fix: range and category checks (spelling-insensitive), vocabulary scan removes the evidence's own labels first
defects.evidence: RPT-E05/E06, live check of the Deep Caries report

defects.title: POST /api/reviews accepted an image-level review for an image id that does not exist and stored an orphan row
defects.root_cause: image existence was only checked for region-level actions
defects.fix: route validates the image id (404)

defects.title: A checkpoint whose bytes did not match the sha256 in its sidecar was still registered as dental-trained
defects.root_cause: registry validated sidecar fields only; the recorded checkpoint_sha256 was never compared with the file
defects.fix: cached sha256 comparison during the scan; mismatch -> rejected with a reason

defects.title: Job errors and log tails exposed raw tracebacks and absolute local paths through GET /api/training/jobs
defects.root_cause: stderr tails were stored and served verbatim
defects.fix: short_error serves the final exception line; strip_paths reduces absolute paths (including paths with spaces) to file names; raw text stays in the DB

defects.title: /api/health with service probes took 6.5-8 s when TensorBoard/Label Studio were not running
defects.root_cause: 'localhost' tried over IPv6 first on Windows; the two probes ran one after the other
defects.fix: probe 127.0.0.1 and run both probes concurrently (about 2 s)

defects.title: Wrong HTTP status codes: unknown job id -> 400 (should be 404); explaining a too-small region -> 503 (should be 422)
defects.root_cause: generic DentaMindError / ModelUnavailableError used
defects.fix: NotFoundError and ImageValidationError

defects.title: Upload-limit message said 'the limit is 26 MB' for a 25 MiB limit
defects.root_cause: bytes divided by 1e6 for the limit and the file size
defects.fix: MiB arithmetic

defects.title: Active-learning rounds did not record which model produced the uncertainty signals (model_version null)
defects.root_cause: model_version only taken from the request body
defects.fix: store the model(s) behind the selected images' signals; random draws record none
defects.evidence: rounds created before the fix show null

defects.title: Controls that silently did nothing or were disabled without explanation: Active Learning steps 5/6 before a selection, Back on step 1, Annotations Pull / Approve / Reject
defects.root_cause: click handlers ignored the click; no title on disabled buttons
defects.fix: disabled with an explanatory title

defects.title: Recorded dataset provenance (splits_sha) changed whenever the dataset was re-processed, even though no image moved
defects.root_cause: sha256 of the whole splits file, which contains an 'updated' timestamp
defects.fix: added assignments_sha (canonical hash of image id -> split); the historical sidecars carry the old file hashes and cannot be re-verified byte-for-byte
defects.evidence: dataset_version of the AL reproduction differs from the original in manifest_sha/splits_sha only; split sizes and the 65-radiograph/331-crop validation set are identical

defects.title: run_al_experiment.py and evaluate_model.py could only overwrite Data/reports; AL runs stored no selection manifests, so selections were not reproducible or auditable
defects.root_cause: fixed output folder, metrics-only records
defects.fix: --out-dir, --device, --no-db; per-round labeled_sha and selected_next manifest; evaluation reproduction skips the numbering registration write-back

defects.title: /api/health returns version 'unknown' (also printed by check_running.ps1)
defects.root_cause: version comes from installed package metadata; the project is run from source
defects.fix: backend/version.py APP_VERSION = '0.2.0' (same as FastAPI and frontend/package.json) used by main.py and /api/health
defects.evidence: API-002 PASS; SEC2-03; check_running.ps1 prints version=0.2.0

defects.title: Stopping the supervisor of start_backend.ps1 (--reload) on Windows leaves an orphan worker holding the port
defects.root_cause: uvicorn reload spawns a worker that inherits the listening socket
defects.fix: documented: stop the process tree (taskkill /T)
